mentions.name: Zig64
mentions.description: Zig64 is a Zig library for developing N64 homebrew. It provides low-level control of the console's hardware, including framebuffer output, and is adding support for the RDP (the N64's rasterizing GPU component) so programs can draw triangles. It defines packed structs for all RDP commands with documentation, and builds a CommandList struct that constructs RDP command lists and validates them (correct subcommand ordering for triangle/rectangle rendering, framebuffer rendering target present, synchronization commands in place).
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been resuming work on a Zig library for developing N64 homebrew¹.  Previous milestone was getting a framebuffer onto the screen, and after achieving that I took an overly-long break.

Current goal, which I've been working on for a bit more than a week now, is to add support for controlling the RDP (the part of the N64's GPU that actually does all the rasterization), such that programs can actually draw triangles.
mentions.author: yellowapple
